rust_summary: Possible natural spawn entries, mutable and cancellable (`native_potential_spawns`).
doc_summary: `native_potential_spawns(dimension, category, pos, entries, canceled)`, run on the server when natural spawning builds its possible spawn list (NeoForge's `LevelEvent.PotentialSpawns`, vanilla's `NaturalSpawner.mobsAt`). Mods may edit the list or cancel and read the world, but cannot write it during the spawn pass. Bundles need "hooks": @API:native_potential_spawns@.
